_doc: Ordered plan driven by pilot.py, one Slurm job at a time. Each step runs `cmd` from the repository root on a GPU node ($ODY_REPO, $ODY_OLD, $ODY_DATA, $ODY_CONDA_ENV and $RUN_DIR are set; python is the conda env). 'gate' is a Python expression on status and on col('<xp>/<file>.csv', '<column>'), the mean of a column of a CSV written during the step under consistency/sbatch_submission/results/. A step with 'confirm': true waits for `pilot.py approve <id>`.

steps.cmd: python -c "import torch, papermill, yaml, pandas; print('torch', torch.__version__, 'cuda', torch.cuda.is_available(), torch.cuda.get_device_name(0) if torch.cuda.is_available() else '')" && ls -la $ODY_DATA
bash odyssey/inventory.sh > $RUN_DIR/inventory.txt; cat $RUN_DIR/inventory.txt

ln -sfn $ODY_DATA data && for d in logs_CT_CM_spde logs_CT_VarCM_spde_grad logs_CT_DynCM_spde logs_CT_VarDynCM_spde_grad logs_FM_spde logs_DynFM_spde; do [ -e consistency/Notebooks/Notebooks_GP/$d ] || cp -r $ODY_OLD/consistency/Notebooks/Notebooks_GP/$d consistency/Notebooks/Notebooks_GP/; done && du -sh consistency/Notebooks/Notebooks_GP/logs_* && python -c "import xarray as xr; ds = xr.open_dataset('data/SPDE_diffusion_dataset_1.nc'); print(ds); [print(k, ds[k].attrs) for k in ds.data_vars]"
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && MAX_EPOCHS_OVERRIDE=3 python run_training.py --xp GP --method CMT
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && MAX_EPOCHS_OVERRIDE=3 python run_training.py --xp GP --method VarCMT
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && python run_training.py --xp GP --method CMT && python run_metrics.py --xp GP --method CMT

steps.gate: status == 'ok' and len([k for k in metrics if k.startswith('GP/StochVarCM_')]) >= 3
steps.cmd: for c in grad obs; do d=consistency/Notebooks/Notebooks_GP/logs_CT_VarCM_stoch_spde_$c; [ -e $d ] || cp -r $ODY_OLD/$d $d; done && python consistency/rebuttal/eval_stochvarcm_gp.py --cond grad obs --members 20 --nsteps 40

cd consistency/sbatch_submission && for m in FM DynFM CM VarCM DynCM VarDynCM; do [ -f results/GP/${m}_metrics_calibration.csv ] && { echo "[skip] $m already evaluated"; continue; }; python run_metrics.py --xp GP --method $m || exit 1; done && python make_latex_table.py --xp GP || true
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && python run_training.py --xp GP --method VarCMT && python run_metrics.py --xp GP --method VarCMT
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && MAX_EPOCHS_OVERRIDE=3 python run_training.py --xp GP --method DynCMT
cd consistency/sbatch_submission/results/GP && for n in VarCM VarDynCM; do for f in ${n}_metrics*.csv; do [ -e "$f" ] && mv "$f" "${f/${n}_metrics/${n}_v1_metrics}"; done; done; ls
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && MAX_EPOCHS_OVERRIDE=2 python run_training.py --xp GP --method VarCM
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && MAX_EPOCHS_OVERRIDE=2 python run_training.py --xp GP --method VarDynCM
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && python run_training.py --xp GP --method VarCM && python run_metrics.py --xp GP --method VarCM
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && python run_training.py --xp GP --method VarDynCM && python run_metrics.py --xp GP --method VarDynCM
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && python run_training.py --xp GP --method DynCMT && python run_metrics.py --xp GP --method DynCMT
cd consistency/sbatch_submission/results/GP && for f in VarCM_metrics*.csv; do mv "$f" "${f/VarCM_metrics/VarCM_crps1_metrics}"; done; ls VarCM*
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && MAX_EPOCHS_OVERRIDE=2 python run_training.py --xp GP --method VarCM
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && python run_training.py --xp GP --method VarCM && python run_metrics.py --xp GP --method VarCM
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && python run_metrics.py --xp GP --method DynCMT
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && python run_training.py --xp GP --method VarDynCM && python run_metrics.py --xp GP --method VarDynCM
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && for m in CMT DynCMT; do python run_metrics.py --xp GP --method $m || exit 1; done

cd consistency/sbatch_submission && (cd results/GP && for f in VarCM_metrics*.csv; do cp "$f" "${f/VarCM_metrics/VarCM_crps2_metrics}"; done) && python run_training.py --xp GP --method VarCM && python run_metrics.py --xp GP --method VarCM

for d in logs_FM_ssh_gf logs_CT_CM_ssh_gf logs_DynFM_ssh_gf logs_CT_DynCM_ssh_gf; do [ -e consistency/Notebooks/Notebooks_SSH_GF/$d ] || cp -r $ODY_OLD/consistency/Notebooks/Notebooks_SSH_GF/$d consistency/Notebooks/Notebooks_SSH_GF/; done && du -sh consistency/Notebooks/Notebooks_SSH_GF/logs_*

cd consistency/sbatch_submission && MAX_EPOCHS_OVERRIDE=1 python run_training.py --xp GP --method VarDynCM_ls01 --reset && MAX_EPOCHS_OVERRIDE=1 python run_training.py --xp GP --method VarCM_ls01 --reset
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && python run_training.py --xp GP --method VarDynCM_ls01 --reset && python run_metrics.py --xp GP --method VarDynCM_ls01
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && python run_training.py --xp GP --method VarCM_ls01 --reset && python run_metrics.py --xp GP --method VarCM_ls01

ls -la consistency/Notebooks/Notebooks_GP/logs_VarDynCM_crps_spde_grad/checkpoints; cd consistency/sbatch_submission && python run_nfe_sweep.py --method VarCM --grid 1,2,4,8,15 && python run_nfe_sweep.py --method VarDynCM --grid 2,3,5,10,20 && cat results/GP/VarCM_nfe_sweep.csv results/GP/VarDynCM_nfe_sweep.csv
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && MAX_EPOCHS_OVERRIDE=3 python run_training.py --xp SSH_GF --method CMT

cd consistency/sbatch_submission && for m in FM CM DynFM DynCM; do [ -f results/SSH_GF/${m}_metrics_calibration.csv ] && { echo "[skip] $m"; continue; }; python run_metrics.py --xp SSH_GF --method $m || exit 1; done
cd consistency/sbatch_submission && python run_training.py --xp SSH_GF --method CMT && python run_metrics.py --xp SSH_GF --method CMT
